q2_gaps: a non-deictic season expression ('the late summer of Year 1'): the Time section defines structured terms only for Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute and bare symbols only for deictic times (last_spring, next_summer) and day-parts, so a calendar-anchored season — and a degree modifier on it ('late') — has no licensed term; the bare late_summer symbol used here is an extension by analogy with day-parts, not something the instruction set states
notes: Agent for 'arrive' is right for the animate 'who' (self-powered mover), though the instruction set lists 'arrive' in both the un-powered-relocation -> Theme bullet and the motion/volitional -> Agent list. Location (not Goal) for 'in Aelmere', the Name binding of the named place, the bare $who answer variable and Past are all per the Queries section.
